主要内容: On May 28, 2013, DISH DBS Corporation, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of DISH Network Corporation, issued $1.25 billion aggregate principal amount of its 5% Senior Notes due 2017 at an issue price of 100% of the principal amount. The Company also issued $1.35 billion aggregate principal amount of its 6.25% Senior Notes due 2023 under a separate indenture. The Notes were issued at par value to finance DISH Network's proposed merger with Sprint Nextel Corporation. The Notes were sold in a private placement under Regulation S and Rule 144A. The net proceeds were placed into escrow and will be used to make a cash distribution to DISH Network. If the merger does not occur or the cash consideration is less than $2.6 billion by May 28, 2014, the Company will redeem the Notes at 100% or 101% of their principal amount, plus accrued interest. The 2017 Notes have a 5% annual interest rate and mature on May 15, 2017. The 2023 Notes have a 6.25% annual interest rate and mature on May 15, 2023.
